query: SELECT action.id AS "action_id!: i64", action.sequence_id, action.result_content_id, agent_history.branch_id AS "branch_id!: i64" FROM action JOIN speech ON speech.action_id = action.id JOIN player_character ON player_character.character_id = speech.speaker_character_id JOIN agent_history ON agent_history.agent_id = player_character.agent_id WHERE action.requesting_tool_execution_id = ?
